selection: Identical seed-0 grid for both encoders; highest validation median per-gene Pearson, then lowest MSE, then canonical config. No encoder sweep. D0 is deterministic and fitted once for selected config; D1 has three seeds. Frozen C1 optimizer/training settings for all D1 fits.
scaling: C4 feature and target scalers fitted on primary training patients, or the other three fold-training patients for conditional sensitivity. Frozen C0 targets/panels/order unchanged.
conditional: All four panels, both models, both encoders, all four held-out patients. Primary-selected configs fixed. D1 epoch count is rounded median primary best epoch per encoder/panel. No held-out early stopping.
negative_controls: Phikon S2-50, D0 and D1, training-label permutation and training-feature-location permutation, seeds 0/1/2. Validation/test unchanged. Store permutation hashes.

gate.PASS: At least one multi-gene panel meets all primary/subset/patient/Ridge criteria, both negative controls pass for both models, integrity passes
gate.MIXED: No PASS, but at least one multi-gene D1 panel has median paired gain >=0.01 or at least 5 percent genes meet the strong-gene rule
gate.TECHNICAL: Any failed extraction/order/replay/frozen-input audit or failed negative control overrides status to FAIL_TECHNICAL

capacity_note: Identical hidden-width/dropout families and tuning budgets. Input dimension differs (512 versus 768), so absolute downstream parameter counts differ; no claim of exact parameter matching. Ridge provides an additional family check.
test_discipline: Model/release/extraction config fixed without outcomes. Extract train/validation first; write selection lock before test-image extraction and final expression evaluation. Prior C0-C3 test results are already known: development, not untouched confirmation.
stop: C4B only after clear PASS_PATHOLOGY_REPRESENTATION; otherwise stop for review. No optional second encoder, no multiresolution or sparse-ST execution.
